purpose: Separate the huge LOSO-vs-Test-S1 rejection gap (E183 gate: LOSO ~0.98 vs S1 0.2733 at a=0.90) into three candidate causes: A = the held-out identity still participates in feature fitting (task-wise z statistics / PCA), B = the threshold reference distribution differs, C = one-identity-per-fold vs five-identity-pooled estimation. Reads every source read-only; never writes into an existing experiment directory.

protocol.blocks_rule: block = clip(int(frac * 5), 0, 4) per (subject, task) trial order

e65_distance.definition: E143 protocol: per-task z, PCA-96, k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity), score = -nearest-prototype distance
e65_distance.contaminated_instrument: task-wise mean/std from all Train rows of the task, PCA basis from fit_rows of all 20 identities
e65_distance.strict_instrument: task-wise mean/std from the other 19 identities' Train rows, PCA basis from the other 19 identities' fit_rows, prototypes from the other 19 identities' fit_rows
e65_distance.deployment_prototype_rows: all Train rows for the Test score and the 5-block OOF reference (E143 convention); LOSO folds use fit_rows only

e183_fusion.definition: E183 selected gate: 0.85*g_head + 0.10*g_dist + 0.05*g_entropy, g_head = conf_max_over_views (identity-head max softmax, z-scored on the fold's training rows)
e183_fusion.contaminated_counterfactual: re-train the 20 x 3 heads with the E143-style transform (z statistics and PCA basis fitted on all 20 identities' Train rows, the held-out identity included) while keeping prototypes and head training rows restricted to the 19 enrolled identities
e183_fusion.strict: as published in E183 (every fold statistic already excludes the held-out identity)

head.note: copied verbatim from E183 config.json; the counterfactual run changes only the feature transform

domain_probe.space: deployment instrument = per-task z (all Train) + PCA-96 fitted on all Train fit_rows, applied unchanged to Test
domain_probe.shift_metric: per task: mean |mu_test - mu_train| / sd_train over the 96 PCA scores, plus ||mu_test - mu_train|| / sd_train (Euclidean, per-dim sd)
domain_probe.separability: per task 5-fold stratified CV logistic regression, AUC(Train vs Test-S1), AUC(Train vs Test-S2), AUC(S1 vs S2)

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test is only scored. Session is read only to split the audit into S1 / S2.
